name: Soju (소주)
description: Korean spirit. Distilled alcohol (rice, barley, or starch), Water, Optional sweeteners or flavorings, Flavors: Green grape, peach, yogurt, plum, grapefruit, more

name: Makgeolli (막걸리)
description: Milky rice wine. Steamed rice, Nuruk (fermenting agent), Water

name: Boricha (보리차)
description: Roasted barley tea. Roasted barley, Water

name: Sikhye (식혜)
description: Sweet rice punch. Malted barley water, Cooked rice, Sugar, Pine nuts

name: Yuzu Tea (유자차)
description: Yuzu marmalade, Hot water, Honey, Ginger (optional)

name: Korean Soft Drinks
description: Chilsung Cider (lemon-lime soda), Milkis (carbonated milk soda), Bong Bong (grape juice with pulp), Sac Sac (orange juice with pulp)
